climate: Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Chardonnay and Riesling sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.
A dry climate, with little rain while the vines grow. Water is scarce and the dry air keeps disease down.

blurb.text: A south-central Washington AVA within Columbia Valley, south of Yakima Valley and north of the Columbia River. Cabernet Sauvignon covers 43% of plantings, then Merlot at 16% and Chardonnay at 12%.
